:::{#exm-wald-poisson}
#### Wald interval and test for a Poisson rate

For $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$,
$\hat\rate_{\text{ML}} = \bar x$ and $\einf(\rate) = n/\rate$
(@exm-dist-mle-poisson),
so $\HSE{\hat\rate} = \sqrt{\bar x/n}$.
With $n = 13$ and $\bar x = 72/13$,
the 95% Wald interval for $\rate$,
and the Wald test of $H_0: \rate = 4$, are:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
n_obs <- 13
xbar_obs <- 72 / 13
se_rate <- sqrt(xbar_obs / n_obs)
z_wald <- (xbar_obs - 4) / se_rate
c(
  lower = xbar_obs - qnorm(0.975) * se_rate,
  upper = xbar_obs + qnorm(0.975) * se_rate,
  z = z_wald,
  p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_wald))
)
```

:::
